User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the application.

Annotation.title: Annotation
Annotation.description: Represents a user's annotation on a portion of a verse.

translation.description: The Bible translation used (e.g., BSB, WEB).

book.description: The book of the Bible (e.g., JHN).

start.description: The starting character offset of the annotated text within the verse.

end.description: The ending character offset of the annotated text within the verse.

text.description: The selected text content that is being annotated.

note.description: User's note for the selected text.

highlight.description: Highlight style applied to the selected text (e.g., hl-yellow, hl-green).

underline.description: Underline style applied to the selected text (e.g., ul-red, ul-purple).

drawingDataUrl.description: A data URL representing a user's handwritten drawing on the text.

definition.description: Stores user profiles. User ID is used as the document ID.

params.description: The unique identifier of the user.

definition.description: Stores individual annotations for each user. The annotationId is a unique ID.

params.name: annotationId

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore structure is designed to ensure data isolation and efficient querying. Annotations are stored as a subcollection under each user's document, enabling path-based ownership and simplified security rules. This approach allows for multiple granular annotations per verse and supports efficient querying for all annotations within a specific chapter for a user.
